preheader: Anthropic exercises its greenshoe option, ATP expands player payouts, and Signal fights screen-scraping AI.

lead.headline: Anthropic pulls in $93.5 billion after underwriters exercise greenshoe option
lead.body: Underwriters for Anthropic officially exercised their overallotment option on Friday, lifting total funds raised in the stock offering to $93.5 billion. The artificial intelligence firm sold 1.127 billion shares at $83 each. The extra share allotment marks the final phase of the record public listing.
lead.why: Understanding how investment banks use greenshoe allotments to meet demand is a core corporate finance topic you will see in Merage valuation courses and banking interviews.

stories.headline: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest buys $91 million in Anthropic while trimming Nvidia
stories.body: Ark Invest scooped up nearly one million shares of Anthropic on its opening day across six funds, totaling about $90.8 million. At the same time, Ark sold 33,430 shares of chipmaker Nvidia.
stories.why: This is a clean case study in portfolio management: fund managers often trim hardware winners to reallocate cash into software and foundation models.

stories.headline: Gold slides toward its worst week in eight months
stories.body: Gold prices fell again on Friday as traders priced in a resilient dollar and weighed the likelihood of an interest rate hike in December. Broad declines across commodities suggest inflation pressures could be easing.
stories.why: In macroeconomics, rate hike expectations drive investors toward yield-bearing assets and away from precious metals that pay no interest.

stories.headline: Signal restricts screenshots to block AI agents from scraping messages
stories.body: Signal rolled out updates on iOS and Android to prevent users and external tools from taking screenshots. The messaging platform called screen-reading AI agents hostile to user privacy.
stories.why: If you look to build consumer software, expect to navigate fresh tensions between agent-driven automation and strict user privacy boundaries.

stories.headline: Most consumers view AI-generated branding as cheap and lazy, survey says
stories.body: An Accenture Song report found that 56% of respondents in India feel brands using artificial intelligence for ads and content look cheap, lazy, and careless. The research highlights growing consumer pushback against unedited automated marketing.
stories.why: When preparing Merage marketing presentations or launching a venture, remember that using raw AI copy can actively harm your brand reputation.

stories.headline: BCG projects India's capital goods market will reach $1.2 trillion
stories.body: A joint report by CII and BCG projects India's capital goods sector will expand to between $1 trillion and $1.2 trillion by 2047. The growth is fueled by heavy spending on data centers, semiconductors, clean energy, and defense.
stories.why: Keep this thesis in mind for consulting case interviews focused on emerging markets, industrial manufacturing, and cross-border infrastructure investing.

stories.headline: Tech companies expand AI teams while reducing entry-level headcounts
stories.body: Nearly nine out of ten employers in India plan to grow their tech teams for AI, according to hiring data, but most anticipate cutting total staff over the coming years. Recruiters are shifting budgets toward specialized roles instead of entry-level positions.
stories.why: To secure business and tech internships, you will need demonstrable technical or analytical projects rather than just general business administration skills.

stories.headline: UC Irvine men's basketball drops tight matchup to Stanford
stories.body: The Anteaters led for most of the game before Stanford mounted an 8-0 run over the final two and a half minutes to win 65-61. The defeat drops UC Irvine to a 3-1 record on the season.

stories.headline: ATP Tour approves $350 million compensation structure starting in 2028
stories.body: The ATP approved changes to its OneVision plan that will expand total player prize money and financial rewards past $350 million by 2028, up from $270 million this year. The expanded plan provides guaranteed baseline support and higher payouts for up to 250 men's players.

term.name: Greenshoe option
term.definition: A provision in an underwriting agreement that permits investment banks to sell up to 15% more shares than originally planned at the initial offer price. Banks exercise it when investor demand is exceptionally strong, helping stabilize trading and letting the issuing firm collect extra capital. Anthropic's bankers exercised theirs on Friday to lift total proceeds to $93.5 billion.

serve.headline: Model ML raised $250M to build AI agents for financiers and consultants
serve.body: London-based Model ML develops specialized AI agents that handle analytical workflows for investment bankers, strategy consultants, and private equity firms. The company closed a $250 million Series B round at a $1.5 billion valuation co-led by General Atlantic and QED Investors.
